description: Without an exterior inclined perturber, Kozai-Lidov resonance is inactive. Planetesimals remain trapped in Neptune scattering corridor (q <= 36 AU) with no perihelion lifting.
Quadrupole secular coupling excites large-amplitude eccentricity oscillations, lifting perihelia above 40 AU, but lacks high-inclination orbit flipping and asymmetric apsidal clustering.

model_name: Full Secular Dynamics (Quadrupole + Octupole + Giant Planets)
description: Complete secular engine reproducing sustained perihelion lifting for Sedna (q=76 AU) and 2012 VP113 (q=80.5 AU), apsidal confinement (Delta varpi ~ 180 deg), and high detached fraction.
